verdict_text: YES. The script removes blocks 2, 6, 10, 14 by regex-matched index, renumbers survivors in original order via enumerate over the kept list (old 3→2, 4→3, 5→4, 7→5, 8→6, 9→7, 11→8, 12→9, 13→10, 15→11), copies non-block tensors and all values/shapes/dtypes untouched into a fresh dict (so no in-place overwrite collisions), and asserts before writing that the surviving layer index set is exactly {0..11} (which rules out any block 12–15 and guarantees exactly 12 blocks) and that the tensor count is 184. Both checks precede `save_file`, so a failure raises `AssertionError` with a non-zero exit and no output written, and the file lands at `out/T1/model.safetensors` as required.
